label: Ezra

text.BHSA NEH 12:12: וּבִימֵי֙ יֹֽויָקִ֔ים הָי֥וּ כֹהֲנִ֖ים רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָבֹ֑ות לִשְׂרָיָ֣ה מְרָיָ֔ה לְיִרְמְיָ֖ה חֲנַנְיָֽה׃
text.KJV NEH 12:12: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
text.KJV NEH 12:13: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
text.KJV NEH 12:14: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

A.name: Ezra
A.line: son of Seraiah (EZR 7:1), scribe skilled in the Law (EZR 7:6)
A.notes: as "priest" would be a descendant of Aaron
family: son-of seraiah-2 (Seraiah, the chief priest (2KI 25:18) who was killed by the king of B)
priest-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
scribe-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
descendant-of hilkiah-2 (Hilkiah, the high priest of King Josiah's reign (2KI 22:4, 2CH 34:9))

B.name: Ezra
B.line: Priest who returned with Zerubbabel and Jeshua; ancestor of a priestly house later headed by Meshullam
family: companion-of zerubbabel-2 (Zerubbabel, returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (EZR 2:2, N)

why: The Hebrew לְעֶזְרָא מְשֻׁלָּם (“of Ezra, Meshullam”) identifies Meshullam as head of Ezra’s priestly house in Joiakim’s days (v. 12). This matches B’s stated house headed by Meshullam; the passage provides no identifying connection to A, the scribe descended from Seraiah.
